title: Orchard Studio: options before commitments
question: Which proposed improvements deserve further investigation, and what must we learn first?

sources.title: Original fictional planning exercise
sources.location: Authored for DiagramCloud on 2026-10-20; no actual organization, running agents or measured effort.

groups.label: Reader experience

ideas.title: Search only the permitted content
ideas.problem: Search must not reveal excluded client material.
ideas.proposal: Use an explicitly access-filtered search projection and test denied cases.
benefits: Makes a specific question easier to inspect.
risks: The example is fictional; actual effort and applicability are not measured.
unknowns: Which real user journey and acceptance evidence should define success?
conditions: An owner must select real work independently of viewing this proposal.
